Open your heart and your spiritual eye with the HU mantra

HU is a sacred sound and ancient mantra. It is a love song to God that can uplift people of any religion, culture, or walk of life. When sung or chanted with an open heart, it opens the lines of communication to the most sacred part of yourself.
Singing HU acts as a tuning fork, aligning Soul to higher states of love, creativity, healing, and awareness.
At a Sound of Soul event, you are welcome to join others in chanting this ancient mantra for fifteen to twenty minutes, followed by a short time for contemplation. Afterwards, enjoy spiritual conversation with others of like heart.

id: Business Continuity Planning-Wellington Chamber Of CommerceWellington, Wellington-Event Brite
name: Business Continuity Planning
long_description:
Overview



This practical Business Continuity Planning workshop helps small and medium-sized businesses prepare for disruption before it happens.
Could your business keep operating if something unexpected happened tomorrow?
Disruptions don’t wait until you’re ready. Severe weather, supplier delays, cyber incidents, key staff absence, power outages, cash flow pressure or system failures can all stop normal operations fast.
This practical workshop will help you understand what a Business Continuity Plan is, why it matters, and how to start building one that works for your business.
You’ll learn how to identify your most critical business activities, understand the risks that could interrupt them, and put simple steps in place to keep operating, recover faster and communicate clearly when things go wrong.
What you’ll walk away with
A clear understanding of what a Business Continuity Plan should include
A practical framework to assess, prepare, respond and review
Tools to identify your critical processes, dependencies and recovery priorities
Simple steps to strengthen your business resilience over 30, 60 and 90 days
Confidence to start your plan without waiting for it to be perfect
Who should attend
This workshop is designed for New Zealand small and medium-sized business owners, managers and decision-makers who want to be better prepared for disruption.
Why attend
Because a simple plan started today could make all the difference when disruption arrives tomorrow.

Workshop details
📅 Friday 21 August 2026
⏰ 9am to 12:00pm
📍 Business Central/Wellington Chamber of Commerce (NTT Tower, L13, 157 Lambton Quay, Wellington)
🚀 Provided by Wellington NZ
Spaces are limited so register fast to secure your spot!
